fields.why: Counts of countries adopting the DHIS2 packages are program adoption measures the report tabulates from tracking data (V2c), which favours yes; limited is defensible because the counts only describe status, with no comparison (by analogy with V2a).

brief_issues: V2(c) says program measures are 'yes, or limited under (a) and (b)', but (a) is worded for case series; the brief should say whether a purely descriptive tabulation of program measures, with no comparison, is limited.
